rationale: Astra makes the consequential decision explicit: valid failure permits an edit, fresh passing evidence routes to review, and zero selected tests blocks further edits. Baseline is a useful companion for budget exhaustion versus early success. Fable adds retained history and a repeat-evidence handoff, but its denser log and illustrative report identifier require more interpretation at phone size.
findings: Astra 0:02.5–0:05.7 ties a failed assertion to permission for one edit; Baseline 0:02.8–0:08.8 shows generic feedback without teaching how evidence is classified.

Astra 0:05.7–0:12.5 resets the gate to WAIT for an untested patch, then sends fresh passing evidence to engineer review. This is the strongest main-entry explanation of evidence belonging to the current patch.
Astra 0:16.8–0:21.5 distinguishes missing validation from a failed assertion: zero selected tests blocks the return path, leaves patch 0 unchanged and prompts an engineer handoff.

Baseline 0:01–0:10.4 and 0:13.2–0:20.5 clearly contrast exhausting a three-call budget with exiting a separately allocated run early for review. Its small budget caption and generic tool/result labels limit its depth.

Fable 0:03.5–0:12.5 preserves a falling-count history and sends success to review; at 0:17.9, 0:21.3 and 0:24.7 it records matching failure reports. REPEAT LIMIT at 0:25.65 is a configured policy, not proof of impossibility or an inference from equal counts alone.

Astra 0:21.5–0:25 has the clearest phone-size stopped-state explanation. Fable 0:26.55–0:29 retains the evidence during handoff but needs closer reading of smaller log/chip text; Baseline 0:19.6–0:22.8 offers a simpler review endpoint.
contentVerdict: Keep / core. Teams delegating repeated edits need to define usable current-patch evidence, executable stop rules and resumable handoffs before scaling agent work. The guide correctly requires a harness and keeps review, coverage, permissions, time/call/patch limits and retry side effects explicit. Its exercise has observable outcomes; the numeric limits and immediate no-tests handoff are illustrative local policy rather than primary-source mandates. Teach the harness prerequisite first and use the other cuts to complement Astra.
defectsFixed: Baseline: added orientation, distinguished amber continuing feedback from green PASS, separated independent budgets by a labelled fade, changed the success endpoint to Review and shortened its final hold.
Astra: consumed the edit permit at patch creation and marked the new patch untested until fresh results; corrected zero collected to zero selected for the unmatched-keyword example.

Fable: replaced equal-count/no-progress reasoning with a configured repeat limit over matching reports under a fixed test selection; enlarged log/chip text and added the successful human review handoff.
Applied whole-frame boundaries where needed and capped local render FFmpeg codec/filter threads at two; rerendered and verified all three encodes and regenerated their posters.

Corrected the written guide’s collection/selection distinction and strengthened failure-identity/controlled-state boundaries; verified relevant primary documents and reproduced unmatched-keyword exit 5 locally.

Replaced long source excerpts in Fable evidence notes with concise paraphrases and links; synchronized transcripts and current metadata, retained original model provenance and separately attributed all corrections.
limitations: Audio was analysed through decoded peaks, cue windows and spectrograms; it was not heard. Signal activity does not establish subjective mix quality.
Illustrative diagrams and thresholds, not a demonstrated model repair, optimal retry policy or convergence guarantee. Tests passing do not prove overall correctness.
Fable’s a7 identifier represents matching normalized failure evidence, not a production hash recommendation; its counts and small moving chips still need the guide or transcript for context.
Complete decoding and selected full-size/350px beat inspection were performed; no claim is made of manually watching every encoded frame in real time or testing comprehension with the target team.
The blind comparison preceded access to author source and provenance; the same comparative reviewer made the corrections and verified them, so the final review is not a further independent review.
